rationale: The agent verified identity properly using full name plus zip and matched to a single user. It reviewed the user’s orders, identified the relevant tablet, and asked for explicit confirmation before making any changes. When the user required a credit card refund, the agent checked and correctly explained that the original payment for the chosen order was a gift card, so a credit card refund was not possible, and offered compliant alternatives. The user then chose to return all items from that order for a gift card refund. The agent restated the exact change, obtained an explicit “yes” confirmation, and only then executed the return via the tool, specifying all item_ids and the correct gift card payment_method_id. Final information given was consistent with the tool action and policy. Minor quibble: the agent initially suggested the refund would go to the credit card before confirming feasibility, but it corrected this prior to any write and proceeded correctly thereafter. Overall, the request was completed in line with policy.
